entities.summary: Prince Krzysztof Zbaraski was a Polish–Lithuanian member of the gentry social class (szlachta). During his life he was a Master of the Stables of the Crown, a member of special committee for Cossacks and tariffs, a skilled diplomat, and a politician of the Polish–Lithuanian Commonwealth. He was Starost of Kremenets, Wiślica, Hrubieszów and Bolesławiec.
